observations: Stacked wooden pallets on uneven ground in an outdoor yard (photos 0–2).
Some pallets show stamps/markings on deck boards (photos 0–2), but the exact stamp text is not fully readable.
One photo shows a pallet face that appears grey/dirty or weathered (photo 3).
No clear close-up of pallet type (e.g., 4-way entry vs 2-way) or dimensions.
No visible plastic wrap, moisture barrier, or packaging details.

claims.evidence: Photos show stamped pallets (photos 0–2) but the exact “foreign” origin/type is not clearly readable.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Pallets look weathered and the ground is dirty; photo 3 shows a pallet face that appears grey/dirty (possible moisture/soiling), so “clean and dry” can’t be confirmed remotely.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No scale ticket, timestamp, or photo of the certified scale reading is provided.

risks.risk: Moisture/rot or infestation (wood pallets can be damp, moldy, or have pests even if claimed dry).
risks.proof: A close-up video of the pallet boards showing dryness (no dark wet patches), plus a moisture meter reading (or at least photos of board ends and underside) and a quick smell check on camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used pallets that may be damp/unsuitable for premium reuse (worst case: treat as lower-grade/needs sorting).

risks.risk: Condition variability: broken slats, loose nails, or warped pallets reducing usable quantity.
risks.proof: A short clip showing 10–20 pallets being pulled out from the stack with visible underside/deck boards and any broken parts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed condition pallets (worst case: assume some are damaged and reduce resale value).

risks.risk: “Foreign”/specific pallet type not confirmed; stamps may not match the claimed category.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the stamp marks on at least 5 pallets (front and side), with the full stamp text readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used wooden pallets (worst case: no premium for foreign type).

risks.risk: Weight claim may not match actual delivered weight (500 kg) due to pallet count/stacking and scale verification.
risks.proof: Photo of the certified scale display with the pallet load, plus a receipt/ticket showing date/time and weight.
risks.if_unproven: Price based on worst-case delivered quantity/weight uncertainty (treat as not guaranteed 500 kg).

risks.risk: Contamination: dirt, debris, or chemical residues (outdoor yard exposure).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of pallet surfaces and board ends, and a quick wipe test on camera (showing residue).
risks.if_unproven: Price as pallets requiring cleaning/sorting (worst case: lower buyer acceptance).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of pallet stamps/markings (front + side) with readable text for at least 5 pallets.
Video showing the condition of multiple pallets (pull-out sample) including underside and any broken slats/nails.
Moisture/dryness proof: moisture meter reading or close-up evidence of no damp patches (plus underside shots).
Scale proof: photo/video of the certified scale reading with date/time and weight ticket.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a stack of used wooden pallets, but key pricing drivers (actual weight verification, dryness/cleanliness, and pallet type/“foreign” confirmation) are not provable from the images alone. To price safely, request the scale proof and clear stamp/condition close-ups.
